name: UFC | svc.read_execution
description: Read-only: returns a compact summary of one n8n execution (error, failing node, trimmed samples per node) so AI diagnosers never load whole web pages or large data.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ jsonrpc: '2.0', id: 1, method: 'tools/call', params: { name: 'get_workflow_execution', arguments: Object.assign({ workflowId: String($json.workflow_id), executionId: String($json.execution_id), includeData: true, truncateData: 2 }, $json.node_names ? { nodeNames: String($json.node_names).split(',').map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean) } : {}) } }) }}
